Hessa visibly relaxes, smiles and welcomes the party, recalls her grandfather wishing better for the crossing, offers handshake and introduces herself by name. She volunteers to show them the old stair and indicates the safer path around her landing; ordinary neighborly introduction, no fee or agreement yet. V has not yet accepted the handshake, guidance or entered the site. No roll: sincere reassurance consistent with existing grant's preservation of actual dwelling/access/landing/return-channel rights, Hessa's voluntary reaction; no contested bargain or guaranteed future trust. Time Day331~16:22. No resource or custody change.
